title_zh: 决定扫描旧照片并用信封避光存放

scenario.label_zh: 决定扫描旧照片并用信封避光存放
scenario.goal_zh: 在拍摄和扫描之间选择扫描，约定避免强光并用合适信封保存旧照片

context_zh: 兄妹整理家庭老照片，选择数字化和暂时存放的方式。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Could I use the camera flash to photograph these? The room is quite dark.

sentences.speaker: Ethan
sentences.text: It will probably reflect off the shiny surface. Let us use the scanner instead.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: I was going to leave the photos on the sunny windowsill while we worked.

sentences.speaker: Ethan
sentences.text: Please do not expose them to direct sunlight. We can keep them on the table away from the window.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Then I will put each one in a separate envelope when we finish.

sentences.speaker: Ethan
sentences.text: Use these photo-storage envelopes. They will also reduce exposure to light while the photos are put away.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: All right. I will scan them one at a time and write the names on the envelopes, not on the photographs.

sentences.speaker: Ethan
sentences.text: I will check the scans against the originals before we put everything away.
